Title: Enhancement in mechanical properties through an FCC-to-HCP phase transformation in an Fe-17.5Mn-10Co-12.5Cr-5Ni-5Si (in at%) medium-entropy alloy
Primary_Reason: New MEA family; five exact tensile conditions across four grain sizes and two temperatures; direct FCC->HCP TRIP at 298 K and 77 K; direct post-fracture EBSD phase fractions; TEM mechanism evidence; cryogenic pre-test stacking-fault state.
